title: reference_*.md frontmatter
description: Mandatory YAML frontmatter contract for every memory-mirror/reference_<source_id>.md file. The body sections are described in memory-mirror/README.md.

source_id.description: Must match an id in sources/literature-watch.yaml.

last_observed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the observation this file reflects.

last_observed_commit_or_version.description: Commit SHA, version tag, or edition/date the observation pins to.

snapshot_path.description: Relative path of the raw snapshot under memory-mirror/_raw_snapshots/. Optional for hand-authored baselines that predate snapshotting.

provenance_chain.description: Append-only audit trail. One entry per observation that changed this file.

commit.description: Repo commit SHA of the merge that landed this change.

change.description: Severity of the change recorded by this entry.
